name: Simple Note
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, adventurer. I believe she was sent by the warrior trainer Harutt. If this note is from Harutt, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
narrative.objectives: Read the Simple Note and speak to Harutt Thunderhorn in Camp Narache.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Each of us plays a role in our tribe. Each of us must also go through all the same rites. Do not ever let your pride tell you otherwise.

I remain here to train new warriors that seek the glory of battle and who follow the ways of our oldest ancestors. When you feel ready, come back to me and I will do what I can to train you further. Go with the tribe's blessing, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, at last, you've arrived, warrior. I did not lie in my note, adventurer. We are a special breed also, not unlike the druids or shamans of our tribe. You are just as important. We are the ones called upon to defend our borders, to hunt the centaur, and to go to war.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 1 to 2, 210 XP in all.

quests.name: The Hunt Begins
quests.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.
